profile.name: Nguyen Manh Dung
profile.title: Backend Software Engineer
profile.location: Tan Phu, Ho Chi Minh City
profile.careerObjective: Aspiring to grow into a Senior Backend Engineer / Technical Lead, specializing in high-concurrency distributed systems and scalable backend architecture. Seeking to take ownership of architectural decisions, improve system reliability and performance, and design effective data and service architectures while mentoring engineers and strengthening engineering practices across the team.
profile.summary: Backend Software Engineer with 2.5+ years of experience designing, building, and optimizing scalable, high-concurrency backend systems. Strong foundation in system design, concurrency, data consistency, performance optimization, and distributed systems, with hands-on experience delivering production solutions that improve system efficiency, reliability, and scalability. Key achievements include reducing API response times from over 1 second to under 200 ms, decreasing direct database reads by 80% during peak traffic, and building high-throughput processing pipelines capable of handling over 1 million records and exporting multi-GB reports while maintaining low memory consumption. Experienced in architectural design, caching strategies, asynchronous processing, service communication, and automated testing. Also contributed to service decomposition and CQRS adoption, achieving 90%+ test coverage across business-critical modules, and mentored two interns who subsequently transitioned to full-time engineering roles.
